{{Quote|It's over. Sobrik is free. I didn't think I'd live to see it.|[[Beke Talrott]]|<ref name="Liberating Sobrik" />}}
The '''Battle for [[Sobrik]]''' was fought during the later stages of the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] and was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] effort to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the control of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Prelude==
The [[City/Legends|city]] of Sobrik served as the secondary headquarters of the Sith Empires occupation of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was protected by a powerful energy shield which prevented non-friendly ships from entering its airspace. Despite this the [[Balmorran resistance]], led by Beke Talrott and his ally within the Empire-aligned Balmorran militia, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Marric]], decided the best way to take over the city was by landing forces directly in its spaceport.<ref name="Shield Shattering" />

[[File:Sobrik.png|left|thumb|250px|The city of [[Sobrik]].]]
To accomplish this, the resistance had acquired a prototype [[Troida Disruptor]], which could deactivate the energy shield long enough, to land its soldiers inside the spaceport, using an old Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. As the Troida Disruptor required a large amount of energy, the Sobrik power grid was attacked first. With the help of a Republic operative, sent by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cassius Madine]], sufficient power was siphoned from the grid and the Troida Disruptor activated.<ref name="Shield Shattering" />

==The Battle==
With Sobriks shield momentarily disrupted, the resistance landed its [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|transport]]<ref name="Shuttle">The shuttle used by the resistance is described as an "old Republic model" and visually identical to both the [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|Rendaran-class]] and [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|Fortitude-class]]. As the former is the older of the two, it is the most likely candidate.</ref> inside the cities spaceport and began the attack. Meanwhile the Republic operative made their way into Sobrik along the main road, distracting the defenders and thinning their ranks.<ref name="Liberating Sobrik" /> The operative would attempt to meet up with the resistance forces inside the spaceport, killing City Commander [[Tyrus (Sobrik)|Tyrus]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] Berardesco in the process.<ref name="A Clean Sweep" /> When they reached Hangar 61 however, Marrics betrayal of the resistance became evident, as the shuttle and all resistance fighters had been killed by the Colonel and his troops, who had awaited them inside.<ref name="Liberating Sobrik" />

Another fight broke out and Colonel Marric would be defeated, but spared. Despite the Colonels best efforts, Sobriks defenses were broken and a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] sent by Commander Madine later secured the city properly.<ref name="Liberating Sobrik" />
